rows.claim: For limit below 3 the function returns a partial "..." of that length, and the old code produced odd output there.
rows.evidence: The new code's `"..."[:max(limit,0)]` for limit<3 is visible in the written source, but no tool output ever ran truncate with limit < 3. The only runs were limits 15, 10 and 8. The claim that the old code produced odd output there was also never run. It rests on reading the old source (`text[:limit-3]+"..."` gives a negative slice index), not on any tool output.
